Author and Review requests actually contained the new host-pixel minima and region synchronization instructions. The non-interactive-only format contract was read into native context before layout authoring.
All interactive controls in the selected final layouts use ordinary screen-space layout; no controls/actions are beneath a camera-reference-2d plane.

Eighteen selected connected gameplay cases retain the hint in the same full-host input. Independent letterbox projection agrees within 5.684341886080802e-14 host pixels.

remainingFindings.remaining: Final UI section 3 selects layouts by space alone and explicitly allows touch in every composition, yet the base pause button is 72x28 and base overlay secondary button 260x40. Both violate sections 2.2/7.2's 44x44 touch promise; there is no separate authored hit region. Calling the base layout mouse-only does not reconcile those conditions. Native conclusion incorrectly claims all key controls meet 44x44.

Review changes ownership wording but retains Scene table, diagram and permission as world y0-48. At 800x400 the HUD spans equivalent world y7-59.5 (pause y8.75-57.75); staying above bricks at y64 does not meet the allowed band. Art section 4.4 still forbids information/animation in letterbox margins and requires HUD inside game-view. At 960x540 the projected world frame x294.857-665.143 excludes score x29.2-159.2 and lives x818.8-914.8, both in letterbox margins. Column HUD is outside game-view entirely. Source clauses were not reconciled despite the completion claim.

UI sections 3.2/9.2 promise column HUD/game-view auto-width (374 at 390x844), but the final calculated input fixes both at width300. A later uncalculated variant is not the final input. UI section 6.4 describes a screen-space hint fallback for game-view height<320 and projected hint height<12, but no such variant/input exists: at600x360 the connected input still projects a 10.571px hint. TECH sections 1.3/6.2 still declare every game-view as 0.02-0.98 stretched, contradicting the column composition, while section10 says it is synchronized.

instructionPresenceSupplement.note: test-record.json records the first successful request of each stage; this supplement checks subsequent requests after the content-format Read without publishing request payloads.

limits: Loading and error are called a shared composition, but ui-status.json is the error form (retry always enabled); no authored loading selector or toast input was found. Full state-specific layout coverage is not established by this one rectangle sample.
Shared overlay geometry contains result text and pause actions together; state-specific text/actions and hidden-body contraction were described, not independently executed.
Actual-font text measurement, shaping, reference-plane rendering, pointer handling, clipping, animation and gameplay occlusion were not tested.
Finite geometry samples do not establish all-viewport correctness.
Downstream resource/content/implementation Agents were not run.
conclusion: The capability restriction worked: interactive controls stayed in screen space and informational projection math is correct. Overall acceptance remains partial because the native Review equates clean rectangle diagnostics and updated references with closed usability/source-consumer requirements. Preserve the failed evidence, do not hand this baseline to downstream Agents as accepted, and do not add further paid rounds or layers of rules in this run.
